audit_result.proof_trace: Three exported server actions — `getMemberDisplayName` (members.ts:149), `getAllMemberNames` (members.ts:182), and `ensureGenerationRoleExists` (generations.ts:48) — are `"use server"` exports that call external APIs or the Discord bot without first calling `supabase.auth.getUser()`. Next.js registers every such export with an action ID embedded in the public JS bundle; an unauthenticated caller who extracts the ID can POST directly to `/_next/server/actions/[hash]`, bypassing the middleware redirect. The middleware itself also exempts all `/api` paths from the unauthenticated-redirect guard (middleware.ts:51), though the individual API route handlers do add their own checks.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker loads the public `/login` page, extracts server-action IDs from the JS bundle, and POSTs to the `getAllMemberNames` action ID without a session cookie — receiving the full Discord UID-to-display-name map for all club members, and optionally triggering arbitrary Discord role creation via `ensureGenerationRoleExists`.

PROP-stem-system-pre-001.text: All server actions must verify authenticated session via supabase.auth.getUser() before processing.
